title: Bound all admitted weak realizations by a paid trial residual and calibration error
statement: Let w=v-a for actual weak v under b+e and smooth trial a under b. Divergence-free transport skew symmetry cancels b.grad w and e.grad w. Integrating the nonlinear cross term by parts and Holder/Gagliardo-Nirenberg gives |integral a.(w.grad)w|<=C||a||6 ||w||2^(1/2)||grad w||2^(3/2). Young absorbs dissipation and yields d||w||2^2/dt<=C nu^-3||a||6^4||w||2^2+C nu^-1[||r||_(homogeneousH^-1)^2+||e||infinity^2||a||2^2]. Residual is paired in mean-zero homogeneousH^-1; calibration integrates (e.grad)a by parts. A certified L6_tL6_x trial bound gives a finite explicit Gronwall factor and all-input/error endpoint certificate. Transport amplitude/frequency does not enter separately, but the trial norm is NOT free or control-independent. This does not construct a passing common pulse. Quantitative refinement: on unitT3, mean-zero periodic vectors obey ||w||6<=16||grad w||2, proved by three-coordinate fundamental-theorem/Cauchy bounds and periodic tent cutoffs, giving12+18/(pi sqrt3)<16. Thus E-prime<=432nu^-3||a||6^4 E+2nu^-1[||r||_-1^2+||e||infinity^2||a||2^2]. For0<nu,tau<=1 choose rational S6>=max_i integral|a_i|^6,A2>=max_i integral||a_i||2^2,beta=432nu^-3(1+S6),K=ceil(2beta),P=2^K as an ORDINARY integer. Put q=epsilon/(4P),eta=nu*epsilon/[32P(1+A2)]. GIVEN a common control, an L2 q-net of the WHOLE H1 ball, trials initially at its centers, endpoints<=epsilon/2 and integrated residual<=nu*epsilon^2/(32P), all admitted inputs/calibrations/weak realizations satisfy E(tau)<=3epsilon^2/16 and terminal norm<=(2+sqrt3)epsilon/4<epsilon. This is SOUND GIVEN-certificate verification only; universal existence or a selector is NOT supplied.
